title: Fern Plugin Registry Descriptor
description: Metadata descriptor placed at plugins/<plugin-id>.json to publish or update a plugin in the official Fern plugin registry.

id.description: Plugin identifier matching the descriptor filename (plugins/<id>.json) and manifest.json id.

version.description: Release version matching manifest.json version (for example "1.0.0"), no '..' or URL-unsafe characters.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the plugin archive (.zip).

sha256.description: Required lowercase 64-character hex SHA-256 checksum of the source archive.

homepage.description: Optional public HTTPS URL for the plugin repository or documentation.

min_fern_version.description: Optional minimum Fern desktop version required by this plugin.

tags.description: Optional discovery tags displayed in Fern's plugin catalog.
